(2021) use the Itombwe Nature Reserve boundary as a hard exclusion layer in DR Congo agroforestry suitability mapping. Pinto et al. (2019) use protected area boundaries as planning zones in Montado conservation prioritisation.

managed_forage_without_grazing.note: GPW grassland + GLW4 ruminants support scoping; livestock density alone does not prove grazing. Local management interpretation required.

justification: Evidence-backed categorical gate. Castle Table 2 (PDF p8) defines alley cropping on annual cropland or forage grown between tree rows without grazing, excluding existing tree crops. WorldCover 40 maps annual cropland. WorldCover 30 is conditional on a verified managed-forage/non-grazing mask; it is not treated as pasture proof. Built-up, permanent snow/ice and permanent water cannot satisfy this host definition. Tree/shrub cover remains unknown because those classes mix farms and non-farms.

farmland_context.note: Agricultural, fallow or former-farmland identity; degradation alone cannot establish this context.

relationship_params.condition_role: Depletion/degradation characterize restoration need, not universal suitability. No severity cutoff established.

justification: Evidence-backed categorical gate. WOCAT 507 describes restoring degraded wasteland and improving depleted farmland (Kenya example, PDF p1). Within the regeneration-on-farmland family, WorldCover alone cannot identify degradation or farmland history. Positive classes require observed depleted/degraded farmland masks; bare soil alone is never evidence of restoration potential. This gate establishes land-use compatibility, not regeneration success or rootstock presence. Tree cover remains unresolved. Pete input review 2026-10-20: depletion/degradation are targeting context; non-cropland requires farmland identity.

grazing_system_present.note: Local grazing confirmation required for both GPW grassland classes. GLW density cannot replace confirmation.

justification: Evidence-backed categorical gate. Castle Table 2 (PDF p8) defines trees integrated with forage and grazing animals on pasture/grassland. WorldCover grassland requires independent grazing-system confirmation. Other vegetation classes remain unresolved because they may mix wooded pasture, natural vegetation and other systems. Supporting evidence remains held by Pete; default execution returns pending_evidence_review until that review is resolved. Pete clarification 2026-10-20: GPW cultivated or natural/semi-natural grassland plus local grazing confirmation; no GLW substitute.

field_boundary_zone.note: Upload field-boundary geometry and locally justified buffered zone; no global buffer width.

justification: Candidate applicability gate for windbreaks/shelterbelts only. Castle Table 2 PDF p8 places windbreaks on delineated cropland/pasture field boundaries in the US Midwest. WorldCover cropland requires independently mapped field-boundary placement; grassland additionally requires managed pasture confirmation. No universal buffer width or contour-siting rule is inferred. Report applicability zones and candidate line length, never eligible pixel area as planting footprint. Source and cross-context mapping remain pending review. Pete Steward approved B1 on 2026-10-20: boundary geometry required; buffer width varies by publications and regions. Field delineation may be less available in African extensive systems; missing geometry remains unknown. Pete input review 2026-10-20: field boundaries required for both cropland and pasture; no separate pasture-management gate.

coffee_host_fraction.preferred_override: accurate local commodity map; normalize to fraction_of_pixel before evaluation

justification: Pete Steward approved P1 on 2026-10-20: shade agroforestry requires a suitable host crop; OR across crops. Prefer accurate commodity distributions; crop fraction per pixel from MapSPAM is acceptable for high-level scoping. Positive crop fraction establishes host presence, not suitability strength. Retain fractions; no full-pixel area or unverified overlap sum. Source evidence identifies coffee/cocoa systems, not a numeric suitability threshold. No niche-model substitution.
